message.title: Mandatory Notification of Trading by Primary Insiders
message.body:
October 1, 2026 
Ola Nordmann, Chief Investment Officer (CIO) of Nordic Financials ASA, has today through his wholly owned company Nordmann Holding AS, purchased 6,737 shares in Nordic Financials ASA at a price of NOK 1.30 per share. Following this transaction, Nordmann Holding AS owns 2,738,191 shares in Nordic Financials ASA. 

For details see attached KRT 1500.
